# Draft conformance checks

This suite checks the adopted v0.1 working-draft snapshot contract. It is synthetic, versioned with the specification, and does not certify implementations.

## Run the checks

From the repository root:

```sh
python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
python tools/validate_v0_1.py
```

CI uses Python 3.12 and runs the same helper. tools/review_v0_1.py remains a compatibility entry point. Validators use local schemas only and never retrieve evidence URLs. Date-time and URI format checking are mandatory; missing checker dependencies fail explicitly.

## Layers

1. **Structural:** validate the seven schema documents, record/envelope examples and payload, input datasets and output shapes. invalid cases marked structural must fail the named schema (dataset by default).
2. **Semantic:** deduplicate identical records, reject conflicts/aliases, validate reporting boundaries/day counts, cutoff/event ordering, qualification and causal relationships. Missing change/causal evidence remains explicit provisional quality. Semantic rejection cases must match their named error_code.
3. **Calculation:** compare every result field to an explicit expected output, including service/window/cutoff context, quality reasons, candidate counts, ratio scope and separate approximate statistics. A multi-service case uses an array of per-service results; a single-service case uses one object. The helper returns one result per declared service.
4. **Order invariance:** reverse each record collection and require identical per-service results. Array delivery order must not select a revision or alter a statistic.

Fixtures have explicit expected values; expected files are not generated by the calculation helper. Changing an expected result requires checking the accepted specification and recording the rationale. The Python code is an optional verification helper, not a requirement to implement OEMS in Python or an independent second implementation.

## Coverage

The original complete case still has 10 deployments, failure ratio 0.1, rework ratio 0.2, median lead time 9000 seconds and median recovery 1800 seconds. Its nine empty change lists now explicitly declare complete linkage, representing fictional configuration-only/no-new-commit evidence. The unknown-classifications case now marks recovery provisional because unknown failures can hide episode eligibility.

## Remaining boundary

This suite covers the reconciled-snapshot metric profile, not provider ingestion, revision selection, public accreditation or every possible evidence combination. Other calendar profiles, p75 and public conformance-claim policy are separate work. Stable release still requires independent implementation feedback and the gates in VERSIONING.md.
